name: UW ActSci Club
address: M3 1003, RM 1003 University of Waterloo, 200 University Ave W, Waterloo, ON N2L 3G1
about: The UW ActSci Club is the official student-led organization serving Waterloo's Actuarial Science undergraduate students. It is an organization for students with the common interest of pursuing an actuarial career to come together, network, learn, and improve their UW experience.

As UW ActSci Club, we host social events, information sessions, and networking opportunities. We operate a mentorship program to connect new and experienced members, and we offer discount codes for Coaching Actuaries and ACTEX study materials.

Feel free to stop by our office (M3 1003) to learn more about the club and everything we have to offer. Our friendly exec team is always happy to chat, answer your questions, and share advice about courses, exams, and coop.
